Common-emitter NPN amplifier (2N2222 model), 12 V supply, mid-band gain about -50
* Bias: R1/R2 divider gives about 2.1 V at the base, so Ic is about 1 mA.
* Gain is set by Rc||RL over (re + RE1): 4.49k / (about 26 + 62) ohms, roughly 50.
* RE2 is bypassed by CE. Large coupling caps keep the response flat from 10 Hz.
VCC vcc 0 DC 12
VIN in 0 DC 0 AC 1
CIN in b 100u
R1 vcc b 47k
R2 b 0 10k
RC vcc c 4.7k
Q1 c b e Q2N2222
RE1 e e2 62
RE2 e2 0 1.3k
CE e2 0 1000u
COUT c out 100u
RL out 0 100k
.model Q2N2222 NPN(IS=14.34f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=74.03 BF=255.9 NE=1.307 ISE=14.34f IKF=.2847 XTB=1.5 BR=6.092 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=1 CJC=7.306p MJC=.3416 VJC=.75 FC=.5 CJE=22.01p MJE=.377 VJE=.75 TR=46.91n TF=411.1p ITF=.6 VTF=1.7 XTF=3 RB=10)
.control
op
print v(b) v(e) v(c)
ac dec 20 10 10meg
print vm(out) vp(out)
.endc
.end

Common-emitter NPN amplifier, gain about -50, 12 V supply
* Bias: Ve is about 0.55 V, close to the PTAT point, so Ic rises roughly with
* absolute temperature and re = VT/Ic stays nearly constant over -40 to 85 C.
* Gain is about alpha*Rc/(Re_ac + re).
* Rc, Re_ac and the divider resistors are built from equal resistors in series.
* Independent tolerances then partly average out, which tightens the ratios.
* The divider is stiff (about 500 uA) so beta changes barely move the bias.
* Gain was set by hand calculation, not by simulation.

VCC vcc 0 DC 12
VIN in 0 DC 0 AC 1

* Input coupling
CIN in b 100u

* Base bias divider (about 21.6k over 2.4k)
R1A vcc d1 7.2k
R1B d1 d2 7.2k
R1C d2 b 7.2k
R2A b d3 1.2k
R2B d3 0 1.2k

* Collector resistor (about 9.1k, 4 x 2275)
RC1 vcc c1 2275
RC2 c1 c2 2275
RC3 c2 c3 2275
RC4 c3 c 2275

Q1 c b e Q2N2222

* Unbypassed emitter resistor (about 152 ohm, 4 x 38)
RE1 e e1 38
RE2 e1 e2 38
RE3 e2 e3 38
RE4 e3 ex 38

* Bypassed emitter resistor (about 398 ohm)
RE5 ex e4 199
RE6 e4 0 199
CE ex 0 10m

* Output coupling and light load
COUT c out 10u
RL out 0 10Meg

.model Q2N2222 NPN(IS=14.34f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=74.03 BF=255.9 NE=1.307 ISE=14.34f IKF=0.2847 XTB=1.5 BR=6.092 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=1 CJC=7.306p MJC=0.3416 VJC=0.75 FC=0.5 CJE=22.01p MJE=0.377 VJE=0.75 TR=46.91n TF=411.1p ITF=0.6 VTF=1.7 XTF=3 RB=10)

.control
op
print v(b) v(e) v(c) i(VCC)
ac dec 20 10 10meg
print vm(out) vp(out)
.endc

.end
